title: Central banks accelerate CBDC development in response to Bit
content: <div class="tldr-section"><em><strong>TL;DR: Central banks globally are accelerating their Central Bank Digital Currency (CBDC) initiatives, a direct response to the undeniable rise of Bitcoin adoption and the perceived threat it poses to monetary control. As of February 03, 2026, Bitcoin's network operates robustly at block 934,833, secured by a current hashrate of 884.58 EH/s and a difficulty of 146.47 T, standing as an unyielding bastion
